answer_text:
Let the four consecutive natural numbers be  
\[
k,\ k+1,\ k+2,\ k+3 \qquad (k\in \mathbb N).
\]
Their sum of squares is
\[
k^2+(k+1)^2+(k+2)^2+(k+3)^2=4k^2+12k+14.
\]
So we need
\[
n^2+4n+2009=4k^2+12k+14.
\]

Multiply by \(4\):
\[
4n^2+16n+8036=16k^2+48k+56.
\]
Rearranging and completing squares gives
\[
(4k+6)^2-(2n+4)^2=8000.
\]
Thus
\[
\bigl((4k+6)-(2n+4)\bigr)\bigl((4k+6)+(2n+4)\bigr)=8000.
\]

Both factors are even. Let
\[
(4k+6)-(2n+4)=2a,\qquad (4k+6)+(2n+4)=2b.
\]
Then
\[
ab=2000,\qquad a<b,
\]
and
\[
a+b=4k+6,\qquad b-a=2n+4.
\]
Since \(k\) is a natural number, we need
\[
a+b\equiv 6\equiv 2 \pmod 4.
\]
Also
\[
n=\frac{b-a-4}{2}.
\]

Now list factor pairs \((a,b)\) with \(ab=2000\) and \(a<b\):

\[
\begin{array}{c|c|c|c}
a & b & a+b \pmod 4 & n=\frac{b-a-4}{2}\\ \hline
1 & 2000 & 1 & - \\
2 & 1000 & 2 & 497 \\
4 & 500 & 0 & - \\
5 & 400 & 1 & - \\
8 & 250 & 2 & 119 \\
10 & 200 & 2 & 93 \\
16 & 125 & 1 & - \\
20 & 100 & 0 & - \\
25 & 80 & 1 & - \\
40 & 50 & 2 & 3
\end{array}
\]

Thus the valid values of \(n\) are
\[
3,\ 93,\ 119,\ 497.
\]
Their sum is
\[
3+93+119+497=712.
\]

\[
\boxed{712}
\]
